summary: The complete legal domain contains at most ten decimal digits, which is too small for an honest runtime-scaling distinction among digit-extraction methods.

replacement_checks.evidence: The Accepted implementation performs one remainder, one integer division, and constant additional work per decimal digit, for at most ten iterations and O(log n) time.

The certificate regression checks every n from 1 through 100000, 10000 deterministic legal values across the full domain, and four sparse, dense, and maximum boundaries against an independent string-and-place-value oracle.
